# pve_sdn_prefix_list (Data Source)

Reads one SDN prefix list and its ordered entries from `GET /cluster/sdn/prefix-lists/{id}` and `GET /cluster/sdn/prefix-lists/{id}/entries`. Entries carry their upstream sequence in `seq`; PVE evaluates them sequentially and the first match wins.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_sdn_prefix_list" "pl1" {
  id = "pl1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The SDN prefix list identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) The prefix list entries in upstream order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) What to do with matching routes: `permit` or `deny`.
- `ge` (Number) Minimum prefix length to match; null when unset.
- `le` (Number) Maximum prefix length to match; null when unset.
- `prefix` (String) The matched IP or IPv6 prefix, in CIDR notation.
- `seq` (Number) Entry sequence number assigned by PVE (1-4294967295); orders entry evaluation.
